blurb: Guests experience a hot air balloon flight over Utah's stunning landscapes including the Wasatch Mountains and Park City. Flights include a check-in and pilot briefing, balloon inflation viewing, a 45-60 minute flight, and a post-flight champagne toast. The experience lasts about 3 to 4 hours including pre-flight and post-flight activities.

quotes.text: I’ve visited so many different places & experienced so many different things, this is by far the BEST experience I’ve ever had. I had cold feet & was scared to go on but Jake & my wife calmed me down and half way through the Tour I was having the time of my life. I will highly recommend this place, Jake is professional and very knowledgeable. I’ll definitely be back one day.

INCREDIBLE! I did not know how amazing this experience would be, but I was totally blown away. Jake and his crew were like a well-oiled machine. He was able to create a really special experience connecting us to the history of flying while we were in the air, and answering all of our questions along the way. We had a blast. Go have some fun with BigFoot!!

This was one of the most amazing and beautiful experience my wife and I have had. The owner Jake was an amazing person he was very informative and fun when we were up in the air . If you want to have a unique experience definitely book this and you won’t regret it. Thank You Bigfoot Balloons
